title: ADR-017: Version-centric IA — VersionTimeline, severity, endpoint grouping, code-impact language
resolution_note: src/components/diff/VersionTimeline.jsx exists and is wired into the primary surface (commit c6121d0). prettyVersionLabel cleanup landed in 7343c7e. Endpoint grouping + breaking-change severity are described in ADR-017 §2-3 but those are separate scope captured in wp-adr-019-server-diff (oasdiff classification feeds severity) and a future endpoint-grouping workplan — not blocking the IA reframe itself.

done: IntegrationHeader already plumbs integration.versions[] with label+url+optional release date
DiffResult domain type exists in src/core/domain/types.ts
DiffResults + DiffSummary + DiffItem components exist as current flat-table surface

steps.description: Add VersionTimeline component (src/components/diff/VersionTimeline.jsx): horizontal scrollable strip of version dots on a time axis. Props: { versions, selectedV1Idx, selectedV2Idx, onSelect }. Clicking a dot selects it (first click = v1, second = v2, third resets). Renders provider color ticks, version labels below, release date tooltips. Uses ADR-014 tokens.
steps.done_condition: component renders with sample versions; two-click selection updates highlighted dots and triggers onSelect

steps.description: Replace IntegrationHeader dropdown picker with VersionTimeline. Keep product grouping (multi-product providers) as a filter chip row above the timeline. Compare button in the same strip, disabled until two dots selected.
steps.done_condition: IntegrationHeader renders the timeline; selecting two versions and clicking Compare invokes existing onLoadSpecs

steps.description: Add DiffSeverity domain type + classifier in src/core/domain/diff-severity.ts. Pure function `classifyDiff(row: DiffResult): 'breaking'|'non-breaking'|'cosmetic'`. Rules per ADR-017. Unit test with bun test covering each branch.
steps.done_condition: classifier unit-tested; all branches covered; domain imports nothing outside domain/

steps.description: Extend DiffSummary to show a breaking-count callout distinct from added/removed/modified tallies. Red pill with count + 'breaking'. Click filters to breaking-only.
steps.done_condition: summary bar shows breaking count; clicking filters results

steps.description: Add severity chip to DiffItem row (left of current type badge). breaking=red, non-breaking=green, cosmetic=muted. Uses ADR-014 shadow-e0/elevation tokens for consistency.
steps.done_condition: every row shows a severity chip reflecting classifier output

steps.description: Build endpoint grouping: parse METHOD + /path from DiffResult.path (first segment after 'paths.'). Group rows by 'METHOD /path'. Shared schemas group into 'Shared schemas' bucket. DiffResults renders as Accordion (shadcn) with group header: 'POST /charges · 8 changes (3 breaking)'.
steps.done_condition: results display grouped by endpoint; breaking count per group correct; flat/grouped toggle preserved via localStorage

steps.description: Rewrite DiffItem display text to consumer-impact language. Add utility src/lib/impact-phrasing.js that maps (path, type, from, to) → 'Request field X became required', 'Response field Y removed', etc. Fall back to raw JSONPath when no rule matches. Keep 'Show raw JSONPath' toggle.
steps.done_condition: common diff shapes render as plain English; rare shapes fall back to path; toggle surfaces raw view

steps.description: Run bun run typecheck, bun test (new severity tests pass), bun run lint, hex analyze . — all clean. Commit per-step or per-surface as 2-3 commits.
steps.done_condition: typecheck/lint/analyze all green; severity tests pass
